STARTER PROGRAMS | Robot Mission Lab
Open https://makecode.microbit.org/ and create a project.
Add Extensions > kitronik-move-motor (Kitronik).
Switch to JavaScript and replace the starter code with ONE lesson .ts file.
Use the Blocks view if desired. Download using MakeCode to the MICROBIT drive.
These files are editable source, not directly flashable .hex files.
Power the robot off while transferring or adjusting parts. Disconnect USB for floor driving.
Test button B and the physical power switch before every classroom activity.
Lessons 7 and 8 intentionally reuse lesson 6's tested straight-approach baseline.
Lesson 4 is a stationary measurement program; A starts display and B requests display stop.
Physical hardware calibration and classroom testing remain required.
